candidate_helper_declarations.statement_shape: Reassemble sentinel links, the prefix segment, the selected-node links, and the suffix segment into xizi_dll head (nodes_before ++ node :: nodes_after).

separation of the sentinel links from the selected-node links in each selected left return branch

expected_helpers: A group-suffixed split-at lemma proved by induction on nodes_before.
A group-suffixed inverse reassembly lemma proved by induction on nodes_before.
proof_groups.proof_strategy: For each theorem choose the full-list (left) Coq disjunct. Split the original xizi_dll at linklist_node for the entail witness. For return_wit_1, rewrite node_next=head, derive nodes_after=nil from the endpoint case of xizi_dllseg, unfold the value function to 0, and reassemble the unchanged list. For return_wit_2, use node_next<>head with xizi_dllseg_unfold to derive nodes_after=node_next::rest, unfold the value function to node_next, and reassemble the unchanged list.
proof_groups.natural_language_proof_pattern: Bidirectional split/reassembly of the same circular-list segment around the selected node, with a two-case logical-successor observation on the suffix.
proving_hints: The witness definitions are Coq-level disjunctions; proving the full xizi_dll left disjunct is sufficient and preserves the sentinel ownership needed for a clean close.
Use xizi_dll_open/xizi_dll_close and xizi_dllseg_unfold; keep all new reusable induction lemmas in the group-local case_lib with the required group suffix.
Do not treat diagnostic _split_goal_ declarations as target witnesses.
proof_groups.grouping_reason: All three witnesses are inverse phases of one xizi_dllseg split/fold transformation for the same function and use the same two helper candidates. Three witnesses are within the maximum group size of 12, no dependency ordering requires a split, and keeping the helper family in one group avoids cross-group helper sharing.

natural_language_analysis.summary: All three target witnesses are semantically valid under the accepted guarded xizi_dll/xizi_dllseg representation. The left disjunct of each witness retains the complete sentinel-owned list view, so the proofs need only a common split/reassembly family plus the existing endpoint/unfold behavior of xizi_dllseg.

witnesses.space_plan: Apply xizi_dll_open, recursively unfold the segment along nodes_before, then expose exactly one selected-node links block and frame the residual suffix segment. A group-local split-at helper packages this induction.
witnesses.pure_plan: PreH2 directly supplies the requested selected-node non-null fact. The recursive guarded segment supplies selected-node-versus-sentinel and intermediate non-null facts required during unfolding.

witnesses.witness_instantiation: After substituting node_next=linklist_pre, the suffix segment starts at its stop; its guarded definition forces nodes_after=nil (and the predecessor endpoint to match last). The value definition then reduces to 0.
witnesses.space_plan: Use the endpoint/nil case of xizi_dllseg, reassemble prefix + selected-node links + empty suffix into the full segment, then combine with the sentinel links through xizi_dll_close. A group-local reassembly helper packages the prefix induction.
witnesses.pure_plan: PreH1 rewrites node_next to the sentinel. Destructing nodes_after in xizi_dllseg eliminates the cons case because its guard would require linklist_pre<>linklist_pre; the nil case yields nodes_after=nil. Unfolding xizi_double_link_next_rec_last_value proves the return equality.
witnesses.refinement_plan: No refinement or safeExec state is present.

nodes_after=nil: endpoint semantics of xizi_dllseg after substituting PreH1
witnesses.grouping_reason: Empty-suffix instance of the same inverse segment fold.

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Apply xizi_dllseg_unfold with PreH1 to obtain rest and nodes_after=node_next::rest; this equality makes the value function reduce to node_next.

witnesses.pure_plan: PreH1 is exactly the disequality premise of xizi_dllseg_unfold. Its result supplies nodes_after=node_next::rest; rewriting and unfolding xizi_double_link_next_rec_last_value proves reflexivity.
witnesses.refinement_plan: No refinement or safeExec state is present.
